_comment: The three diverse multi-loop CNY curves the ENFORCING saturation-gate default (tau=0.30 / floor=0 / window=3) was calibrated on (2026-06-23). README.md and SKILL.md cite this calibration as the warrant for the gate enforcing by default; tests/test_novelty_gate.py::test_calibration_* re-derives that warrant from this file, so the claim is checkable from a clone with no network and no credential. Each curve is per-loop Confirmed-Novelty Yield (confirmed findings only) from a real 6-loop run.

rejected_params.why: false-fires in the [0,0] valley of the bursty curve (exp3_ai_safety, loop 4) before the burst of 13 arrives — a false positive

honest_limit: tau is UNDER-DETERMINED by this calibration: these curves are tau-invariant (the Stage-1 seen-set dedup dominates the Stage-2 distance test), so tau=0.30 is held over from the prior default, not derived here. floor and window ARE derived.

curves.why: genuinely saturated after loop 1 — the gate SHOULD fire (true positive), and not before loop 5
still producing confirmed findings throughout — the gate must NOT fire
quiet valleys between bursts are not saturation — the gate must NOT fire (this is the curve that rejects window=2)
